integrity: The analytic proof covers every finitely supported integer law, including point masses and initial support gaps. Numerical checks are supplementary; priority has residual bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite-support integer laws only; no claim for unbounded supports.
Ordinary Fourier-modulus monotonicity without all exponential tilts is strictly weaker.
No new general tail bound or computational root-isolation algorithm is claimed.
Classical Bernoulli factorization and real-rootedness are prior mathematical ingredients.
title: Finite-support strong monotonicity characterizes translated Poisson-binomial laws
